title: The Outcast of the Heavens
intro: A mysterious being stands at the crossroads of creation and rejection. Their story is one of unparalleled arrogance and the ultimate defiance of a divine command. Their choice echoes through every generation, becoming a test for every soul born into this world. Can you identify this eternal adversary?
clues: I was present at an event of cosmic significance, when a new being was formed from clay and given life by the Breath of the Merciful.
I myself was brought into existence from a single blazing element, unlike that being of dust.
A command was issued to me that I deemed beneath my station.
Pride swelled within me, and I adamantly refused to comply with that command.
A delay until an appointed Day was granted to me, so that I might pursue my declared purpose of misleading others.
I am the declared enemy of all who walk the earth, whispering deceptions and luring them away from the straight path.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Forged a golden calf for worship
Killed his brother out of envy
Led the polytheist opposition in Makkah

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Granted respite until the Day of Judgment
Drowned along with the army in the sea
Swallowed by the earth along with treasures
Transformed into apes for violating the Sabbath
Burned by stones hurled from the sky
outcome.answer: Granted respite until the Day of Judgment

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ سُلْطَـٰنٌ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
verse: Indeed, there is for him no authority over those who have believed and rely upon their Lord. (16:99)
